name: Banana Berry Yogurt Muffins with White Chocolate Chips

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners and set aside.
Place flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 tbsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a medium bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
Add sugar, oil, and eggs to the bowl with the banana. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup granulated sugar
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Add yogurt and vanilla to the bowl with the egg mixture and whisk once more to combine the wet ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup strawberry yogurt
1 tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Add wet ingredients to the bowl with the dry ingredients and gently stir until almost combined.
Add chocolate chips and dried berries, then stir once more until just combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup white chocolate chips
½ cup dried mixed berries

instructions.primary_message: Fill the muffin liners three-quarters full with batter (about ⅓-cup each). Place muffin pan in the oven and bake until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, about 10 minutes.
To serve, arrange cooled muffins on a platter and enjoy!
